init.title: Откатить миграцию TrueNAS CE?
init.description: TrueNAS Community Edition перенял(а) {count} сущность(ей) и их историю из вашей предыдущей интеграции TrueNAS, которая теперь отключена (не удалена). Оставьте TrueNAS CE или выполните откат, чтобы вернуть сущности и историю старой интеграции. При откате интеграция TrueNAS CE удаляется. Это возможно только пока старая интеграция ещё существует.

cloudsync_run.name: Cloudsync run
cloudsync_run.description: Start a cloudsync job (target the cloudsync sensor).

cloudsync_abort.name: Cloudsync abort
cloudsync_abort.description: Abort a running cloudsync job (target the cloudsync sensor).

rsync_run.name: Rsync run
rsync_run.description: Start an rsync task on demand (target the rsync task sensor).

replication_run.name: Replication run
replication_run.description: Start a replication task on demand (target the replication sensor).

snapshottask_run.name: Snapshot task run
snapshottask_run.description: Run a periodic snapshot task now (target the snapshot task sensor). Note: if the task's naming schema only has minute resolution (e.g. auto-%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M), running it twice within the same minute fails on TrueNAS because the snapshot name already exists.

dataset_snapshot.name: Create dataset snapshot
dataset_snapshot.description: Create an on-demand ZFS snapshot of the targeted dataset. The snapshot is taken immediately and named custom-<timestamp>, independent of any periodic snapshot task (target a dataset sensor).

system_reboot.name: Reboot TrueNAS
system_reboot.description: Reboot the TrueNAS system (target the Uptime sensor).

system_shutdown.name: Shut down TrueNAS
system_shutdown.description: Shut down the TrueNAS system (target the Uptime sensor).

system_refresh.name: Refresh TrueNAS data
system_refresh.description: Force an immediate re-poll of TrueNAS so automations can act on current data without waiting for the next poll (target the Uptime sensor).

service_start.name: Service start
service_start.description: Start a TrueNAS service (target the service binary sensor).

service_stop.name: Service stop
service_stop.description: Stop a TrueNAS service (target the service binary sensor).

service_restart.name: Service restart
service_restart.description: Restart a TrueNAS service (target the service binary sensor).

service_reload.name: Service reload
service_reload.description: Reload a TrueNAS service (target the service binary sensor).

vm_start.name: VM start
vm_start.description: Start a virtual machine (target the VM binary sensor).

overcommit.name: Overcommit memory
overcommit.description: Allow the VM to launch even when there is insufficient free memory.

vm_stop.name: VM stop
vm_stop.description: Stop a virtual machine (target the VM binary sensor).

force.name: Force
force.description: Force an immediate power-off instead of a graceful ACPI shutdown.

vm_restart.name: VM restart
vm_restart.description: Restart a virtual machine (target the VM binary sensor).

container_start.name: Container start
container_start.description: Start a container (Incus instance; target the container binary sensor).

container_stop.name: Container stop
container_stop.description: Stop a container (Incus instance; target the container binary sensor).

container_restart.name: Container restart
container_restart.description: Restart a container (Incus instance; target the container binary sensor).

app_start.name: App start
app_start.description: Start an app (target the app binary sensor).

app_stop.name: App stop
app_stop.description: Stop an app (target the app binary sensor).

dataset_lock.name: Lock dataset
dataset_lock.description: Lock an encrypted dataset (target the dataset sensor).

force_umount.name: Force umount
force_umount.description: Force unmounting of the dataset before locking.

dataset_unlock.name: Unlock dataset
dataset_unlock.description: Unlock an encrypted dataset (target the dataset sensor). If passphrase is omitted, the passphrase stored via passphrase_set (or the ReConfigure flow) is used. Raises an error when neither is available.

passphrase.name: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for this dataset. Leave empty to fall back to the stored passphrase. Note: when supplied here, the value appears once in debug logs and automation traces.

recursive.name: Recursive
recursive.description: Apply the key or passphrase to all encrypted children.

force.name: Force
force.description: Force unlock even if the mount path already exists and is not empty.

passphrase_set.name: Store dataset passphrase
passphrase_set.description: Persist a passphrase for the targeted dataset in the config entry so that dataset_unlock can be called without supplying the passphrase each time. The passphrase is stored in plain text alongside the API key in HA's config storage. Note: the passphrase value appears once in debug logs when this action is called.

passphrase.name: Passphrase
passphrase.description: The passphrase to store for this dataset.

passphrase_remove.name: Remove stored dataset passphrase
passphrase_remove.description: Delete a stored dataset passphrase by its full dataset path. Works for both active datasets and orphaned entries left by a typo. After calling this, dataset_unlock will again require the passphrase field for that dataset.

dataset_path.name: Dataset path
dataset_path.description: Full dataset path as stored, e.g. tank/encrypted or Backup/PP-Test. Must match the key used when the passphrase was stored.

config_entry.name: TrueNAS instance
config_entry.description: TrueNAS instance (optional, defaults to the only/first instance).

passphrase_list.name: List stored dataset passphrases
passphrase_list.description: Return the dataset names for which a passphrase is stored. The passphrases themselves are never included in the response.

config_entry.name: TrueNAS instance
config_entry.description: TrueNAS instance (optional, defaults to the only/first instance).

alert_dismiss.name: Dismiss alert
alert_dismiss.description: Dismiss a TrueNAS alert by UUID.

config_entry.name: TrueNAS instance
config_entry.description: TrueNAS instance (optional, defaults to the only/first instance).

uuid.name: Alert UUID
uuid.description: UUID of the alert to dismiss (visible in the alert_list response).

alert_restore.name: Restore alert
alert_restore.description: Restore (un-dismiss) a TrueNAS alert by UUID.

config_entry.name: TrueNAS instance
config_entry.description: TrueNAS instance (optional, defaults to the only/first instance).

uuid.name: Alert UUID
uuid.description: UUID of the previously dismissed alert to restore.

alert_list.name: List alerts
alert_list.description: List all TrueNAS alerts with UUIDs and formatted messages.

config_entry.name: TrueNAS instance
config_entry.description: TrueNAS instance (optional, defaults to the only/first instance).

properties.name: Properties to include
properties.description: Comma-separated list of properties (e.g. "uuid,formatted,level"). Use "*" for all properties.
